research_instructions: Research one exact model/source at a time. Use only routes that are materially distinct from those listed in Batch 06 results and the predecessor ledgers; do not repeat a route merely to obtain a fresh date.

Use the model-specific official or current seller route only when it can directly establish the field. For public-community evidence, use accessible public forums or owner reports; the XHS extension doctor failed its required CDP preflight in Batch 06, so do not open XHS directly or attempt a workaround.
For Airwolf YF-R003, do not bypass or retry the verification interstitial. A historical foreign owner amount is not current mainland price evidence.
For Uragano EVO, distinguish a current marketplace snapshot, a factory build, and the 2023 reviewed custom build. Do not claim current stock from a dated historical page or merge unlike BOMs.

For stiffness, accept only an instrumented measurement or credible controlled exact-frame comparison. Generic resin claims, qualitative marketing, rider impressions, and another revision do not resolve this field.
Record literal queries and exact route labels when retained. If a research result is handed off only as a normalized summary, label it as such; never invent the literal query or source details.
No manufacturer/seller contact, private content, purchase, image download, image-rights inference, catalog publication, or external GitHub mutation.
done_criteria: Integrate only exact-model evidence that closes an atomic field. Preserve all other gaps with a precise evidence-backed state and concrete reopening trigger; do not call an unrun channel exhausted. Add a dated result matrix for all six fields, accept monotonic coverage, run npm run check once for the coherent batch, and run npm run image:report only if image records change.
delivery_boundary: Local worktree only. No push, pull request, merge, publication, or production change.
